items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: That show featured ... Peg Leg Bates ... a lot of other people that I don't remember

ctx.x: In the fall of 1952, there was a show that had gone out the year before, and it was called The Biggest Show of 1951. That show featured Duke Ellington's band, Sarah Vaughan, George Kirby, an act called Stump and Stumpy, Peg Leg Bates, a lot of other people that I don't remember -- but that show had gone out in 1951. And in 1952, I guess due to the success of the 1951 show, it was decided that they would do it again. Oh, the other person, the main attraction on the show was Nat King Cole.

So they decided to do the show again and call it The Biggest Show of 1952. This show featured the Nat King Cole Trio as the headliner, and then they had Stan Kenton's band, Sarah Vaughan, George Kirby, Peg Leg Bates, Stump and Stumpy, and a few other personalities that doesn't come to mind immediately.
